You let them get away.''"
"''It's too risky with the kids inside. Any idea where they're headed?''"
"''If I told you, you wouldn't believe me.|Kh'ymm and Kent|audio=Khymm-Kent-SC3.flac|}} '''Kent''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who flew as an [[X-wing starfighter]] [[commander]] for the [[New Republic]]'s [[Sector Patrol]]. Around [[9 ABY]], Kent and another [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] were [[Mission to the Observatory Moon|dispatched]] to the [[Observatory Moon]] to arrest the [[pirate]] "[[Jod Na Nawood|Crimson Jack]]" after receiving a [[Distress signal|distress call]] from the [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]]. Above the [[moon]], Kent and the other [[pilot]] gave chase as their target and the [[Youngling|children]] with him escaped aboard their [[Onyx Cinder|starship]] but were unable to stop them without putting the children at risk. The children later contacted Kh'ymm for aid when [[Silvo's pirates|pirates]] [[Invasion of At Attin|took over]] their [[homeworld]] [[At Attin]] and she passed its location onto the New Republic. Kent then led a [[squadron]] to At Attin and defeated the pirates by destroying their [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]]. ==Biography== ===Desparate dispatch=== {{Quote|Observatory moon, come in. This is Sector Patrol, inbound to your position.|Kent tries to contact Kh'ymm|audio=Kent-Inbound-SC3.flac|}} [[File:KentGasGiant-SC3.png|thumb|right|300px|Kent (foreground) and another pilot traveled to the Observatory Moon to arrest Crimson Jack.]] Kent was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] as an [[X-wing starfighter]] [[commander]] in [[Sector Patrol]]. During the [[New Republic Era]] around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} the [[astronomer]]{{Databank|khymm|Kh'ymm}} [[Kh'ymm]] [[Distress signal|contacted]] the New Republic from her [[Observatory Moon]] to report the [[Mission to the Observatory Moon|arrival]] of the [[pirate]] "[[Jod Na Nawood|Crimson Jack]]" with a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[Youngling|children]] that she assumed he had kidnapped. The New Republic sent Kent and another [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] to arrest Crimson Jack, with Kh'ymm offering to stall him until they arrived. As they approached the Observatory Moon in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]], Kent attempted to contact Kh'ymm over [[Comm unit|comms]], informing her that they were inbound and asking for an update on Crimson Jack. The pirate, also known as Jod Na Nawood, overheard the message however and realized that the astronomer was stalling him, drawing a [[blaster pistol]] on her. Kh'ymm refused to call off the X-wings, and after her and Jack fought, the pirate and the children fled from the astronomer's [[Unidentified telescopic array|telescopic array]] just as Kent and the other [[pilot]] conducted a fly-by over the structure. The [[starfighter]]s then began patrolling the area with search lights active.{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}} ===Chasing children=== {{Quote|Crimson Jack, land this ship immediately—|Kent's message is cut off by Crimson Jack|audio=Kent-Land-SC3.flac|}} [[File:KentPursuit-SC3.png|thumb|left|300px|Kent pursued the ''Onyx Cinder'' above the Observatory Moon.]] At their [[starship]], the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'',{{Databank|onyx-cinder|Onyx Cinder}} the children initially refused to board with Na Nawood, and the child [[KB]] amplified her voice to call over the New Republic patrol. However, before the X-wings arrived, Na Nawood convinced the children to board with him and told them that Kent and the other pilot were Kh'ymm's goons and would not help them. The New Republic pilots then spotted the ''Onyx Cinder'' taking off and began pursuing it, firing warning shots at the vessel. Circling around the starship, Kent's fellow pilot contacted the vessel and ordered Crimson Jack to land immediately, although the pirate cut off the transmission before it finished. Na Nawood then had the children [[Wim]] and [[Fern]] man the ''Onyx Cinder's'' gun [[turret]]s and told them to just keep the New Republic pilots back, which they gleefully did by firing scattered shots at the X-wings. The two fighters broke formation and Kent's vessel sustained a glancing blow, but they retaliated with an [[Ion cannon|ion shot]] that deactivated one of the ''Onyx Cinder's'' [[engine]]s. Na Nawood then used the remaining engines to blow up [[moon]] dust behind them, and the X-wings got lost in the cloud as the ''Onyx Cinder'' then jumped to [[hyperspace]]. [[File:KentKhymm-SC3.png|thumb|right|300px|Kh'ymm berated Kent for letting the ''Onyx Cinder'' escape.]] The New Republic pilots then returned to the array and landed, with smoke emerging from Kent's [[cockpit]] as it opened. Kh'ymm flew over to the commander's fighter and berated them for letting the ''Onyx Cinder'' get away, but Kent explained that stopping the vessel would have been too much of a risk with the children on board. They then asked where the ship would be headed, but Kh'ymm told the pilot that they would not believe the answer, as the children were [[Mission to At Attin|trying]] to get home to [[At Attin]], a [[planet]] widely considered to be a myth. ===Delayed saviors=== {{Quote|Lock S-foils in attack position. We're going in.''"
"''Setting shields double forward.|Kent and Cail-tan|audio=Kent-Cail-tan-SC8.flac|{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}}}} The children were soon betrayed by Jack but eventually made it back to At Attin; however, the pirate accompanied them and took control of the planet, [[Invasion of At Attin|bringing]] a [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]] full of [[Silvo's pirates|pirates]] onto the world to oppress its citizens and control the [[At Attin Mint|Old Republic Mint]] located there. With the aid of her friends, KB managed to get a message to Kh'ymm asking for help and revealing At Attin's true location, which she passed on to the New Republic. Kent then led a [[squadron]] of X-wings and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]]s to At Attin, entering the world's [[atmosphere]] after the [[Barrier]] that surrounded the world was deactivated. [[File:XWingAttack-SC8.png|thumb|left|300px|Kent led a squadron in attacking pirates on At Attin.]] Flying down over the [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] being attacked by the pirate's [[frigate]], Kent ordered the squadron to lock their [[S-foils]] in attack position, and after a response from the pilot [[Cail-tan]] and a [[Tarsunt]] [[Unidentified Tarsunt X-wing pilot|squadron member]], the X-wings strafed the top of the pirate vessel. The pirates on the ground began retreating to the frigate on [[dropship]]s and engaged the New Republic fighters as they did so, but once the [[B-wing heavy assault starfighter|B-wings]] hit the frigate, the vessel slowly crashed to the ground, marking the defeat of the pirates. ==Personality and traits== Kent had light skin and was not willing to risk stopping the ''Onyx Cinder'' with the children inside. ==Equipment== [[File:Kent-SC3.png|thumb|right|300px|Kent piloted a T-65B X-wing starfighter.]] Kent wore an [[Color|orange]] [[flight suit]] with a gray [[flight harness]] and [[glove]]s. Their [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was primarily gray with white on the lower portion of the two sides and along the mohawk strip, which had a black line down the center and at the end. A white New Republic [[Rebel Alliance starbird|starbird]] symbol decorated each side of the [[Flight helmet|helmet's]] front in a red bordered section and the sides had a blue square at the base bordered in yellow. Along the top of at least one side Kent had five yellow [[victory decal]]s. The commander flew a T-65B X-wing starfighter with blue markings and a yellow New Republic [[Starbird (symbol)|starbird]] crest on each side. The fighter had [[Aurebesh]] [[writing]] on the side including "LK68" and was equipped with ion [[weapon]]ry on its lower wing tips.{{SW|url=season-1-episode-3-trivia-gallery-skeleton-crew|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Trivia Gallery | Skeleton Crew}} {{C|Slide 5}} ==Behind the scenes== Kent was portrayed by [[Andy Powers]] in the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', first appearing in the third episode, "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," which aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but was listed in the credits. Kent's [[astromech droid]] is inconsistently depicted with a different head shape in different shots, either bearing an [[R4 astromech droid|R4]] or [[R5 series astromech droid|R5]] head. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-103|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Episode 103 "Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem"}} *{{ThisWeek|kpmetxxrzwQ|Dispatch: Escape From Port Borgo}} *{{SWYouTube|X5LHjMV89yw|Skeleton Crew | Official Clip | Episode 3 Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{ThisWeek|ngd8-Smb2uI|Dispatch: At Attin is in Trouble}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Kent|imagecat=Images of Kent}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Kent |ja=ケント |ka=კენტი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:New Republic Starfighter Corps personnel]]
